recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It preserves FHIR-19694's implementer guidance in the current CodeableReference model without changing the later approved MedicationRequest.reason targetProfile list; the related CodeableReference and added-target-profile issues have separate combined-branch decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-19694 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request, raised for STU3 and applied for R5, asking that MedicationRequest reason guidance distinguish diagnosis/problem/condition reasons from therapeutic goal target values. The final resolution clarified that reasonReference is intended for condition/diagnosis/problem support and is not for goals.
initial_application: Pharmacy commit cdb9b154325715da80c5913ec7939955b7d52105, merged by ec284380a4c273eeee93dc77e0ead3366dddec01, applied GF/FHIR-19694 by adding a MedicationRequest.reasonReference comment that it was not intended to reference a goal. Later source refactoring and FHIR-25929's CodeableReference migration retained the formal exclusion of Goal from MedicationRequest.reason reference targets but lost the explicit no-Goal explanatory sentence on the current reason element.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini confirms MedicationRequest is active and maps reasonCode/reasonReference to the current MedicationRequest.reason concept/reference structure. FHIR-25929 is already represented on the combined branch and updated stale reasonReference wording to reason.reference. Later applied Pharmacy issues FHIR-40785, FHIR-40462, and FHIR-51148 added DiagnosticReport, Procedure, and AllergyIntolerance as MedicationRequest.reason reference targets but did not add Goal. Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-19694 or MedicationRequest.reasonReference/Goal discussion, and Confluence hits were agenda/reference mentions without conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: Updated the active MedicationRequest StructureDefinition comment to say that reason.reference is not intended to refer to a Goal, and made the same update in the MedicationRequest Request-pattern mapping-exception mirror so generated comparison source remains aligned.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml: restored the no-Goal clarification on the current MedicationRequest.reason CodeableReference comment.
source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml: kept the Request-pattern mapping exception resource comment aligned with the StructureDefinition comment.
